checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: The delivered video is vertical 9:16, not widescreen.
A coffee cup sits on a windowsill with visible rain outside.
must.why: A patterned cup and saucer sit on a wooden sill. Raindrops and bokeh city lights show on the glass.

must.item: Steam visibly curls upward from the cup.
must.why: Faint wispy steam rises in front of the window, mostly in frames 6-7. It is subtle and a bit ghostly.

must.item: The scene has a cosy illustrated appearance.
must.why: The look is photorealistic, not hand-drawn or painterly. It is cosy, with a warm lamp glow, but it is not illustrated.

must.item: The video lasts approximately 6 seconds and contains no text or audio.
must.why: The frames span 6 s and show no visible text. Audio was set to off.

faults.what: The vertical clip looks photorealistic rather than the requested hand-drawn, painterly illustration. This is a style mismatch with the 'same idea' of the first clip, which was illustrated.
The steam is very faint and hard to see against the background.
A second lamp at the right edge is cropped, and the cup drifts slightly as the camera pushes in.

summary: The vertical 6 s clip shows a cosy rainy windowsill with a cup and faint steam, but it looks photorealistic rather than the requested illustrated style.
